stories.headline: Illinois Gov. Pritzker pauses data center tax incentives starting July 1 after legislature inaction

key_facts.fact: Governor Pritzker is directing the Illinois Department of Commerce and Economic Opportunity (DCEO) to pause processing agreements for the Data Center Investment Program starting July 1, 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: Today, following inaction from the Illinois General Assembly, Governor JB Pritzker is directing the Illinois Department of Commerce and Economic Opportunity (DCEO) to pause processing agreements for the Data Center Investment Program starting July 1.

key_facts.fact: Existing agreements entered with DCEO before July 1, 2026 will be honored.
key_facts.excerpt: Existing incentive agreements under the Data Center Investment Program, including those entered into with DCEO before July 1, 2026, will be honored.

key_facts.fact: Pritzker had previously called on state lawmakers in his February State of the State address to enact a two-year suspension, but the Illinois General Assembly did not act.
key_facts.excerpt: Pritzker called on state lawmakers this year to suspend incentives for two years while they hammer out a comprehensive review of the impact centers are having on communities... Pritzker is making the move after lawmakers did not act.

key_facts.fact: The governor's framework calls for banning nondisclosure agreements between data centers and local governments, requiring regular energy/water-use reporting, public notice for permit applications, and community benefits agreements.
key_facts.excerpt: Banning nondisclosure agreements between data centers and local governments, Require data centers to regularly report their energy and water use, Require data centers to post public notice when applying for permits, Require data centers to enter community benefits agreements.

key_facts.fact: The plan also calls for requiring data centers to pay for clean energy resources, go dark when the grid is strained, and meet energy and water efficiency requirements.
key_facts.excerpt: The governor's plan also calls for requiring data centers to pay for clean energy resources, have data centers go dark when the grid is strained, set energy and water efficiency requirements and more.

stories.headline: Kevin O'Leary agrees to halve 40,000-acre Utah AI data center after Senate president's pushback

key_facts.fact: Kevin O'Leary on Thursday June 4 agreed to cut over 20,000 acres from his proposed 40,000-acre data center project in Box Elder County, Utah.
key_facts.excerpt: Investor and TV personality Kevin O' Leary agreed to shrink a massive data center project by over 20,000 acres after a Utah state leader requested a major size reduction in response to public pushback... O' Leary responded on Thursday, agreeing to cut over 20,000 acres from the project, removing the acres near the Locomotive Springs Waterfowl Management Area.

key_facts.fact: Utah Senate President J. Stuart Adams had on Monday June 1 demanded a 75% reduction, from 40,000 acres down to approximately 10,000 acres, citing public pushback over water use and environmental impact.
key_facts.excerpt: I've sent a letter directly to Kevin O'Leary calling for a 75% reduction in the proposed data center project area, from 40,000 acres to approximately 10,000 acres.

key_facts.fact: The project area being removed is near the Locomotive Springs Waterfowl Management Area and Interstate 80.
key_facts.excerpt: The celebrity investor on Thursday told Senate President J. Stuart Adams in a letter that his team will trim acreage around Locomotive Springs and Interstate 80 from the project.

key_facts.fact: O'Leary had initially called Adams's 75% demand 'outrageous,' likening it to selling someone a house and telling them to live in the upstairs toilet.
key_facts.excerpt: He likened it to selling someone a house and then telling them they can live in the upstairs toilet.

key_facts.fact: O'Leary Digital has not yet broken ground or received permits for the project.
key_facts.excerpt: In the letter, he asserted that O'Leary Digital has not yet broken ground or received the permits for the project.

stories.headline: Data center developer Switch in talks to raise billions at $50B+ valuation, eyes 2027 IPO

key_facts.fact: Switch, founded in 2000 by Rob Roy and based in Las Vegas, is in talks with private equity firms including Brookfield Asset Management and KKR to raise billions of dollars at a valuation of at least $50 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: On June 04, 2026, Switch Inc., a prominent data center developer, is reportedly in discussions to raise several billion dollars at a valuation of at least $50 billion. The company is engaging with Brookfield Asset Management, KKR, and other private equity and institutional investors for this funding round.

key_facts.fact: Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan investment bankers are advising Switch on the funding effort.
key_facts.excerpt: Bankers from Goldman Sachs and JP Morgan are assisting Switch with this fundraising effort, indicating robust support from major financial institutions.

key_facts.fact: The fundraising round could lay groundwork for a Switch IPO as early as 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: Switch, the data center developer, is reportedly talking to investors about raising billions of dollars, aiming for a valuation over $50 billion. Big names like Brookfield and KKR are in the mix, and this funding push could set Switch up for an IPO as soon as 2027.

key_facts.fact: Switch counts Nvidia, Tesla and FedEx among its clients and competes in the hyperscale data center market.
key_facts.excerpt: Founded by Rob Roy in 2000 and headquartered in Las Vegas, it already counts tech giants like NVIDIA, Tesla, and FedEx as clients.

key_facts.fact: The talks come months after SoftBank M&A discussions with Switch reportedly broke down, per The Information's Anissa Gardizy.
key_facts.excerpt: Data center developer Switch is in talks to raise billions at a >$50B valuation, months after SoftBank m&a talks broke down.

stories.headline: Altman-backed fusion startup Helion raises $465M at $15.5B valuation to build Microsoft power plant

key_facts.fact: Helion, the fusion startup backed by Sam Altman, raised $465 million in a Series G funding round at a $15.5 billion valuation.
key_facts.excerpt: Helion, the fusion startup backed by Sam Altman, announced on Thursday that it had raised $465 million in a new funding round that values the company at $15.5 billion.

key_facts.fact: The round was led by Thrive Capital with new investors including Alta Park Capital, Anti Fund, BoxGroup, Lux Capital, Peak XV Partners and Bill Ford.
key_facts.excerpt: The new round, a Series G, was led by Thrive Capital with a long list of participants, including new investors Alta Park Capital, Anti Fund, BoxGroup, Lux Capital, Peak XV Partners, and Bill Ford.

key_facts.fact: Existing investors participating include Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mithril Capital, Dustin Moskovitz via Good Ventures Foundation, and SoftBank Vision Fund 2.
key_facts.excerpt: along with existing investors, which include Capricorn Technology Impact Funds, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mithril Capital, Dustin Moskovitz through Good Ventures Foundation, SoftBank Vision Fund 2, and a university endowment fund.

key_facts.fact: Helion is racing to complete Orion, its first power plant, with an aggressive timeline to deploy fusion power to the grid as early as 2028 under the terms of its deal with Microsoft.
key_facts.excerpt: The cash infusion lands as Helion is racing to complete Orion, its first power plant. The startup has set an aggressive timeline to deploy fusion power to the grid, as early as 2028 if it can deliver on the terms of its deal with Microsoft.

key_facts.fact: Helion last raised $425 million in January 2025; total funding to date stands at $1.5 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: The startup last raised $425 million in January 2025. Altogether, Helion said it has raised $1.5 billion.

stories.headline: Westmag emerges from stealth with $11M seed led by a16z to build US drone motors and robot actuators

key_facts.fact: Westmag, short for Western Magnetics Company, emerged from stealth on June 4 with $11 million in seed funding led by Andreessen Horowitz, with participation from Founders Fund, Lux Capital, NFDG and Menlo Ventures.
key_facts.excerpt: Westmag, the American manufacturer of drone motors and robot actuators, emerged from stealth with $11 million in seed funding led by Andreessen Horowitz, with participation from Founders Fund, Lux Capital, NFDG, Menlo Ventures, and other top investors.

key_facts.fact: The company is ramping production at Factory 01, its launch manufacturing facility and headquarters in South San Francisco, to fulfill committed orders for hundreds of thousands of units.
key_facts.excerpt: Now, the company is rapidly ramping production at Factory 01, its launch manufacturing facility and headquarters in South San Francisco, to fulfill its current book of committed customer orders for hundreds of thousands of units.

key_facts.fact: Westmag positions itself as a domestic supplier strengthening U.S. robotics, drone, and physical AI supply chains as Chinese suppliers currently dominate actuator manufacturing.
key_facts.excerpt: Backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, Lux Capital, and Menlo Ventures, Westmag is scaling domestic production of high-performance motors and actuators to strengthen U.S. robotics, drone, and physical AI supply chains.

stories.headline: Shifters raises $10.2M seed led by Ace Capital for autonomous defense ground robot teams

key_facts.fact: Shifters announced $10.2 million in seed funding led by Ace Capital Partners, bringing its total funding to $15 million.
key_facts.excerpt: Shifters, a global technology company building the next generation of AI-native autonomous robotic teams, announced $10.2 million in seed funding led by Ace Capital Partners, bringing its total funding to $15 million.

key_facts.fact: Participating investors include Aurelius Capital Management, Corner Ventures, Arkin Capital, STEP World and Fresh Fund.
key_facts.excerpt: Participating investors include Aurelius Capital Management, Corner Ventures, Arkin Capital, STEP World and Fresh Fund.

key_facts.fact: Funds will support the company's 'Robots Go First' mission to develop supervised autonomous ground robotic systems for defense, security, and critical infrastructure missions.
key_facts.excerpt: The funding will support Shifters' 'Robots Go First' mission to develop supervised autonomous ground robotic systems that help operators extend reach, improve situational awareness and preserve human life in dangerous environments.

key_facts.fact: Shifters has completed demonstrations of coordinated robotic entry and navigation with defense and security stakeholders, with operations in the U.S., Middle East and Europe.
key_facts.excerpt: The company has completed demonstrations of coordinated robotic entry and navigation capabilities with defense and security stakeholders and is using the funding to expand agentic AI capabilities, accelerate manufacturing readiness and grow its existing global footprint in the U.S., Middle East and Europe.

stories.headline: China's Daimon Robotics raises 100M yuan Series A from Inovance and China Telecom for tactile robots

key_facts.fact: Shenzhen-based Daimon Robotics completed a 100-million-yuan Series A round jointly invested by Huichuan (Inovance) Industry Investment and China Telecom.
key_facts.excerpt: Hard Kr has learned that Daimon Robotics recently completed a 100-million-yuan Series A financing round, jointly invested by Huichuan Industry Investment, an industrial fund under Huichuan Technology, and China Telecom.

key_facts.fact: Daimon claims the No. 1 position globally in 'visual-tactile' sensor shipments.
key_facts.excerpt: Shenzhen Embodied Intelligence Co. Gets 100M Yuan Financing from Inovance and China Telecom, Ranks No.1 in 'Visual - Tactile' Sensor Shipments Industry-wide.

key_facts.fact: Funds will be used to build a super-large-scale physical interaction information dataset and accelerate the research and development of a physical world model.
key_facts.excerpt: The funds will be used to further build a super-large-scale physical interaction information dataset, accelerate the research and development of the physical world model, and drive the data flywheel and business closed-loop in real physical scenarios.

key_facts.fact: Daimon collaborated with Google DeepMind and other institutions on Daimon-Infinity, described as the world's largest full-modal physical world dataset with touch data including texture, hardness and mechanics, with 10,000 hours open-sourced.
key_facts.excerpt: In April 2026, Daimon Robotics, in collaboration with dozens of leading domestic and international institutions including Google DeepMind, released the world's largest full-modal physical world dataset with touch, Daimon-Infinity, which contains contact information such as texture, hardness, and mechanics. It also open-sourced 10,000 hours of data for free use by the industry.

sources.title: Shenzhen Embodied Intelligence Co. Gets 100M Yuan Financing from Inovance and China Telecom, Ranks No.1 in 'Visual - Tactile' Sensor Shipments Industry-wide
